As a matter of cogent fact, White Noise is an addition to Parks' list of probes on American racism, a piercing look into the unending battle among the races. Moreover, it's such an unexpectedly offbeat take-Parks is, of course, often commandingly offbeat-that writing about it in detail is a reviewer...

The genius of White Noise isn't simply in the idea; it's in where Parks-and her tight-knit cast, guided by Public artistic director Oskar Eustis-takes it, and she takes it to some very, very disturbing places.
